title: Handle empty parser input
description: Update the parser so empty input returns an empty result instead of raising IndexError.

nodes.description: The requirement that empty parser input return the established empty result without changing non-empty behavior.
Locate, without guessing a path, the Python parser function that indexes the first token and causes the reported empty-input failure.
Produce the smallest change to the located function that returns the repository's existing empty-result representation for empty input and preserves all non-empty behavior.
Add a regression test for empty input and preserve the existing parser test suite; return the change only when both requirements are represented.
Combine the verified minimal change into one applicable unified diff against the supplied base commit.
Return only the applicable unified diff.

constraints: No behavior change for non-empty input
